title: Spielberg's tip about the Ariel School landing in Africa

tellings.quote: on UFOs he should look into this Landing

plain: The film director Steven Spielberg reportedly passed on a tip that the Ariel School landing was worth looking into. That is a 1990s case at a school in Ruwa, Zimbabwe, where a craft is said to have landed near the children. James Fox, a documentary filmmaker who investigates UFOs, tells it from what he was told, naming Spielberg and the film producer Janet Yang as the people the tip came through. It is part of how he came to investigate the case.
